title: OneSlotChallenge
description: A brutal hardcore mod that locks all inventory slots except the 5th. The remaining 35 slots are filled with permanent barriers. Survive with only one slot if you can!
body: Only true professionals survive with just one slot! All inventory slots except the fifth are blocked by barriers. They can't be removed, dropped, moved, or used. The fifth slot is your only hope for survival. OneSlotChallenge – test your mettle!
